answer: Each identity registers one glacier melt channel cut in basalt and locks an 80-credit bond. It posts a prism gauge reading; an auditor recomputes flow from the glacier melt table and the basalt cross-section, burning the bond on a miss over 5 percent. The first channel costs 34, the kth 34 plus 6 times k minus 1, the 1000th 6028, so 1000 fakes pay 3,031,000 plus 80,000 locked, with no bulk discount, since each channel needs its own serial. A rented-channel ring fails: two claims sharing one prism serial burn both bonds. An honest operator pays 34 once and recovers the bond after audit.
